author: Gian López
abstract: An executable skill for creating and managing tasks in the Notion database "Control" through the Notion connector. It reads the live data-source schema before assigning dynamic catalog properties (Proyecto, Tipo, Módulo, Sprint), reads the workspace's people live so the responsible person is always chosen from the real team, enforces workspace conventions for task naming and content style, replicates the database's default page template, computes start and finish dates from the company's working schedule, appends entries to a task's "Registros" log, each closing on one confirmed field, and closes a task by computing the working hours elapsed since it started, confirming that figure with the user, and writing it alongside the transition to POR APROBAR — the two halves of the company's hour-control scheme, planned and real, measured on one calendar. Every write is guarded by a duplicate check and a mandatory preview-and-approval step. Behavior is governed by a set of user directives covering default values, always-confirmed fields, naming, tone, assignment of the responsible person, the structure of the "Registros" progress log, and the rule that real hours are calculated as an anchor but never written without confirmation.
